domain: implementation-documentation
| workflow = state: Beta

{{Documentation}}
[[Category:BITwiki Templates]]


= Infobox Implementation: Template for Implementation Documentation =

== Purpose ==

This template provides a standardized infobox for documenting implementations in BITwiki. Implementations are concrete realizations of ideas.

== Template Structure ==

```wiki
{{Infobox Implementation
| name = Implementation Name
| image = Image file (optional)
| caption = Image caption
| description = Brief description
| implements = Idea being implemented
| technology = Technology used
| developer = Developer or organization
| release_date = Release date
| status = Active/Deprecated/Experimental
| domain = Application domain
| performance = Performance metrics
| limitations = Known limitations
| epistemic_status = Hypothetical/Emerging/Established/Verified/Axiomatic
| confidence_trajectory = established-developing
| source_count = Number of sources
}}
```

== Parameters ==

=== Required Parameters ===

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| name | String | Implementation name |
| description | Text | Brief description (1-2 sentences) |
| implements | Page | Idea being implemented |
| epistemic_status | Enum | One of five tiers |
| confidence_score | Float | established-1.0 |

=== Optional Parameters ===

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| image | File | Illustrative image |
| caption | Text | Image caption |
| technology | Text | Technology used |
| developer | Page | Developer |
| release_date | Date | Release date |
| status | Enum | Active/Deprecated/Experimental |
| domain | Page | Application domain |
| performance | Text | Performance metrics |
| limitations | Text | Known limitations |
| source_count | Integer | Number of sources |

== Usage Example ==

```wiki
{{Infobox Implementation
| name = Neural Network
| image = Neural_network_diagram.png
| caption = Feedforward neural network architecture
| description = A computational model inspired by biological neural networks, capable of learning patterns from data
| implements = Machine Learning
| technology = Artificial Neural Networks
| developer = Multiple researchers
| release_date = 1943 (McCulloch-Pitts)
| status = Active
| domain = Artificial Intelligence
| performance = State-of-the-art in many tasks
| limitations = Requires large datasets, black box nature
| epistemic_status = Verified
| confidence_score = established
| source_count = 10000
}}
```

== SMW Properties ==

The template automatically generates these SMW properties:

```wiki
[[Has entity type::Implementation]]
[[Has name::{{PAGENAME}}]]
[[Has description::{{{description}}}]]
[[Implements::{{{implements}}}]]
[[Has technology::{{{technology}}}]]
[[Has developer::{{{developer}}}]]
[[Has release date::{{{release_date}}}]]
[[Has status::{{{status}}}]]
[[Has domain::{{{domain}}}]]
[[Has epistemic status::{{{epistemic_status}}}]]
[[Has confidence trajectory::{{{confidence_score}}}]]
[[Has source count::{{{source_count}}}]]
```

== Styling ==

The infobox uses standard BITwiki styling:
* Width: 300px
* Float: Right
* Background: Light green
* Border: 1px solid
* Padding: 10px

== Accessibility ==
* Images must have alt text
* Color not used for meaning
* Screen reader compatible
* Keyboard navigable

== Validation ==

=== Required Fields ===
* name: Must not be empty
* description: Must not be empty
* implements: Must not be empty
* epistemic_status: Must be valid tier
* confidence_score: Must be established-1.0

=== Validation Rules ===

```wiki
{{#if: {{{name|}}} | | [[Category:Infobox missing name]]}}
{{#if: {{{description|}}} | | [[Category:Infobox missing description]]}}
{{#if: {{{implements|}}} | | [[Category:Infobox missing implements]]}}
{{#if: {{{epistemic_status|}}} | | [[Category:Infobox missing epistemic status]]}}
{{#ifexpr: {{{confidence_score|0}}} >= 0 and {{{confidence_score|0}}} <= 1 | | [[Category:Infobox invalid confidence]]}}
```

== Related Templates ==
* [[Template:Infobox Concept]] — For concepts
* [[Template:Infobox Idea]] — For ideas
* [[Template:Infobox Project]] — For projects

== References ==

# Schema.org. (2026). Thing type.
# BITwiki Ontology Index. (2026).
# BITwiki Constitution. (2026).
